MCMC plots of mvgam parameters with bayesplot

Source: R/mcmc_plot.mvgam.R
mcmc_plot.mvgam.Rd

Draws any bayesplot MCMC plot of the posterior, as brms::mcmc_plot() does. Without variable, the plot shows the parameters pairs.mvgam() shows: the population coefficients, the trend parameters and the family parameters.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam'
mcmc_plot(object, type = "intervals", variable = NULL, regex = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

object

An R object typically of class brmsfit

type

The plot type, the name of a bayesplot mcmc_*() function without its prefix. bayesplot::available_mcmc() lists them. The default "intervals" shows posterior intervals. "trace" and "rank_overlay" check mixing. "nuts_energy" and the other "nuts_*" types diagnose the sampler.

variable

Names of the variables (parameters) to plot, as given by a character vector or a regular expression (if regex = TRUE). By default, a hopefully not too large selection of variables is plotted.

regex

Logical; Indicates whether variable should be treated as regular expressions. Defaults to FALSE.

...

Further arguments to the bayesplot function, such as prob for "intervals" or true for the "recover_*" types.

Value

A ggplot object, or a bayesplot_grid for "pairs" and "combo".

See also

mvgam_draws lists the shortcuts variable accepts, such as "trend_params". pairs.mvgam() plots the joint posterior. See the bayesplot MCMC overview.

Other posterior summaries: VarCorr.mvgam(), bibtex(), how_to_cite.mvgam(), hypothesis.mvgam(), index-mvgam, methods_md(), mvgam_draws, pairs.mvgam(), posterior_interval.mvgam(), ranef.mvgam(), smooths.mvgam(), summary.mvgam()

Examples

# \dontrun{
set.seed(13)
simdat <- sim_mvgam(family = poisson(), n_series = 1L,
                     n_timepoints = 120L, trend_model = AR())
mod <- mvgam(y ~ s(x), trend_formula = ~ AR(p = 1),
              data    = simdat$data_train,
              family  = poisson(),
              chains  = 2, silent = 2)
#> Warning: 9 of 2000 (0.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.

# Posterior intervals of the trend parameters
mcmc_plot(mod, variable = "trend_params", type = "intervals")


# Rank histograms of the same parameters check that the chains mix
mcmc_plot(mod, variable = "trend_params", type = "rank_overlay")


# Next, pairs() shows how the parameters covary
# }
